originality.rationale: Inspected the full accessible Thiessen–Gärtner graph-convexity learning preprint (especially Section 4) and the full Tu–Xiao–Lang dissociation-polynomial paper. They do not state the wheel shattering complex, hub exceptions, or exact VC enumerator. published-finding corpus semantic queries and accessible prior claims revealed general wheel-cover-free and fan-dissociation results, neither implies the complete proposed theorem; the existing cycle-convexity shattering theorem concerns a different graph. The dissociation polynomial itself is known and is explicitly not claimed as newly defined. Global priority remains at risk from alternative terminology.

value.rationale: Natural graph-convexity learning class on all wheels receives a full characterization of its shattered-support simplicial complex and polynomial, including the precise contribution of the hub. The exact equivalence to an established cycle dissociation complex is a structural bridge, and the linear VC formula and three-residue-class extremal census quantify how a universal hub transforms the static shattering geometry. Not merely an arbitrary finite numerical sample or trivial upper-bound increment.
